name: pull_request_read
description: Read one Origin-hosted pull request through a single view: summary, files, commits, reviews, comments, or threads. Summary includes labels, requested reviewers, and stack membership (stack id and parent pull request) when the pull request is stacked. The threads view requires threadIds and pages comments in those threads. Comments and threads carry url, a cursor.com link to that thread or comment on the pull request page.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

threadIds.description: Thread ids for the threads view
